subject: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge
body:
From: Elena Moroz <elena@novastack.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the leadership team at Novastack is keen to get the engineering and ops squads up to speed with Redwood Console. We have an all-hands in our main office auditorium next Wednesday (July 30) and would love to run a 60–75 minute hybrid walkthrough: 35–45 minutes console demo + 20–30 minutes Q&A.

Logistics we need to confirm:
- In-person audience: ~25 engineers and 4 ops (auditorium seating).
- Remote participants: ~40 distributed across EMEA and US — will join via our Zoom bridge (we'll provide the room AV).
- Preferred window: 10:00–12:00 local PT (so some overlap for EMEA attendees).
- Security: we cannot share production API keys in the session. Can you provide a temporary sandbox token and a short preflight checklist for access?

Can you confirm availability and whether Redwood can run a 30-minute dry run on July 29 (AV + access + test token)?

Best,
Elena
Director of Engineering | Novastack

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moroz <elena@novastack.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge

Hi Elena — thank you, excited to run this. We can do July 30 at 10:30 PT (60 mins) to hit both local and EMEA overlap. Dry run on July 29 at 11:00 PT works for our team.

Actions from our side:
- I'll coordinate a short preflight checklist and send a sandbox token with limited scope (will expire 48h after the session).
- Ben will own the dry run and AV handoff.
- Priyom will prepare a minimal demo seed project and a slide with troubleshooting steps for the ops audience.

Quick question: will the auditorium projector support presenting from a single laptop + HDMI to the room, while Zoom uses the room system? If the room mixes audio, we want to avoid echo when we unmute.

I'll attach the preflight checklist and an .ics that you can drop into your room calendar.

Thanks — Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf (1 page - items: sandbox token request, attendee roles, laptop + HDMI, stage mic, network whitelist for 52.14.20.0/24)
Attachment: bridge-invite.ics

---

On Tue, 22 Jul 2025 at 12:18:00 -0400, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Elena Moroz <elena@novastack.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 12:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge

Kim / Elena — I can handle the dry run and will be on site the day of the demo if possible. For AV: if Novastack can forward a short test recording route (room mic -> Zoom) we'll run it during the dry run and confirm mute/unmute flow.

Elena: can you share the Zoom room link and the onsite AV contact? Also please confirm whether remote attendees will be in a listen-only mode or able to ask questions (we can manage Q&A through chat + a designated mic operator).

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Elena Moroz <elena@novastack.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@novastack.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 12:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge

Thanks Ben — Zoom link here: https://zoom.us/j/987654321 (I'll email the AV lead). Remote folks will be able to ask questions in chat; we'll posture two room mics for audience questions and a moderator to surface chat Qs.

Ops contact: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novastack.com> (cc'd on separate email).

Also: we have stricter networking rules — the room network is behind a corporate firewall. Is there a short list of IPs to whitelist?

Elena

---

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Elena Moroz <elena@novastack.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge

Elena / Samir (copied separately) — for the dry run we only need to confirm outbound connections to our sandbox endpoints and the ability to fetch tool assets (small thumbnails, ~3MB). Please whitelist the following CIDR for the session: 52.14.20.0/24.

For the sandbox token: I'll generate a scoped token (read-only logs + console viewing) and deliver it via a one-time secret link 24 hours before the session. I will not send tokens over email.

Also: can you provide a list of the ops folks who need admin-level walkthroughs so I can prepare the short troubleshooting doc?

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Platform Engineer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Moroz <elena@novastack.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hybrid console walkthrough — in-person + remote bridge

Elena — thanks for confirming. Final plan below: 

- Demo: July 30, 2025 at 10:30–11:30 PT (Redwood leads: Kimberly, Ben, Priyom; backup: Marissa).
- Dry run: July 29, 2025 at 11:00 PT (Zoom bridge test + sandbox token).
- Attendees: ~25 in-person engineers, ~4 ops (names pending), ~40 remote — ops chat + two room mics.
- Network whitelist: 52.14.20.0/24 (ops to confirm).
- Security: Priyom will issue a scoped sandbox token via one-time link 24h prior; no keys shared by email.

Attachments: redwood-preflight-checklist.pdf, bridge-invite.ics. I've also included a short run-of-show in the checklist: 10:30 intro, 10:35 live demo, 10:55 Q&A, 11:10 wrap.

Please reply-all to confirm attendee list and the AV contact. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Kim
